headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:
今日共收录275篇AI新闻，分类分布：学术研究186篇, 开源项目45篇, 模型发布32篇, 产品/API12篇。热门标签：Agent（63篇）。其中8%的文章有多来源交叉验证。

▸ cathrynlavery /diagram-design：29 editorial diagram types for Claude Code. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows, no Mermaid-slop.

▸ semantica-agi /semantica：Graph-Native Infrastructure for Context and Accountable AI Systems

▸ anthropics /skills：Public repository for Agent Skills

▸ altic-dev /FluidVoice：Fastest and only macOS Dictation app with on-device STT and custom trained AI enhancement model. A l

▸ unslothai /unsloth：Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models, including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4
